name: Illusory Terrain
description:
Casting time: 10 minutes.

You create an illusion out to far range that transforms the appearance, sounds, and smells of the surrounding natural terrain. For example, a marsh might appear as a desert, or a sheer cliff as a gentle slope.

The illusion lasts for 1 day and withstands scrutiny through all senses except touch.

Creatures and constructed features within the area (such as buildings and roads) are not altered, though they may be partially or fully obscured by the illusory terrain. The illusion may not create the appearance of creatures or constructed features.

Describe the illusory terrain.
